item.title: Leadership & Change Management
item.description: Leadership in digital transformation requires balancing technical excellence with empathetic change management 🚀. The Challenge of IT Change in Academic Settings 🎓 Digital transformation in universities is fundamentally a cultural challenge, not just a technical one. At university computing centers (HRZ), resistance to new IT services often stems from communication gaps between IT departments and academic faculties. Common Obstacles: Cultural Silos: Separation between central IT and decentralized institutes Lack of Participation: Solutions developed “over the heads” of end users Communication Deficits: Technical focus instead of benefit-oriented arguments The Change Management Curve 📈 Every new system creates temporary productivity loss.
